llm_request: Please write the text for an Instagram post for an organization called "CSMUN". The post should express excitement about hosting delegates at "The Legend Chiang Rai Boutique River Resort & Spa". It should also highlight pride in providing the best accommodations for the delegates and include a thank you message to the venue for sponsoring the event. Please include appropriate emojis and relevant hashtags.
llm_response:
✨ The countdown is on, and CSMUN is ready to welcome our incredible delegates! 🌍🤝

We are absolutely thrilled to announce that our hosting venue for this year is the breathtaking **The Legend Chiang Rai Boutique River Resort & Spa** 🏝️🥥. 

At CSMUN, we believe that our delegates deserve nothing but the absolute best. That’s why we are so incredibly proud to provide you with top-tier accommodations, where you can unwind in luxury and recharge after a long day of stimulating debates and diplomacy. 🛁🛌💬

A massive and heartfelt THANK YOU to the amazing team at The Legend Chiang Rai for their generosity in sponsoring our event and helping us make this unforgettable experience possible! 🙏✨ We couldn’t do it without your incredible support. 

Get ready for world-class networking, comfortable luxury, and an unforgettable MUN experience in beautiful Chiang Rai. We can’t wait to see you there! 🌟🎓
